description: The token count advertises itself as clickable, and is its segment's only content. The screen is 1280x800. "The tokens" is the first visible ".context-usage-label-tokens"; "the segment" is the first visible ".context-usage-root". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The tokens should be visible (allow 30s). 3. Poll (up to 10s) one eval that reads both texts at once, as the count starts at 0 and changes when usage arrives: the segment's innerText, trimmed, must equal the innerText, trimmed, of the segment's ".context-usage-label-tokens", and must not be "0" (a tooltip whose text changes while it shows goes away, so hover only once usage has arrived). 4. The tokens' computed style must have text-decoration-line exactly "underline", text-decoration-style exactly "dotted" and cursor exactly "pointer". 5. Move the pointer to the viewport point (0, 0) (a hover without a selector), then hover the tokens: ".p-tooltip-text" should contain "Click for details".

steps.expression: (() => { const seg = document.querySelector('.context-usage-root'); const tok = seg.querySelector('.context-usage-label-tokens'); const segText = seg.innerText.trim(); const tokText = tok.innerText.trim(); if (tokText === '0') return 'still 0'; if (segText !== tokText) return `mismatch: seg='${segText}' tok='${tokText}'`; return ''; })()
